Abib Collagen Gel Mask Sedum Jelly is a hydrogel sheet mask formulated to deliver intense hydration while helping skin feel firmer, smoother and visibly refreshed. The gel mask adheres closely to the skin, allowing the nourishing essence to absorb effectively for a comfortable, spa-like treatment at home.

Infused with collagen and hydrating ingredients, it helps replenish moisture, improve the appearance of skin elasticity and leave the complexion looking healthy, plump and radiant. Its cooling hydrogel texture provides a soothing experience, making it ideal for tired or dehydrated skin.

Key Benefits

  • Deeply hydrates and replenishes moisture.
  • Helps improve the appearance of skin firmness and elasticity.
  • Soothes dry, stressed and dehydrated skin.
  • Hydrogel sheet adheres comfortably for better absorption.
  • Leaves skin feeling soft, smooth and refreshed.
  • Provides a healthy, radiant-looking glow.

Ideal For

Dry skin Dehydrated skin Normal skin Combination skin Dull or tired-looking skin
